title: in/on/at (other uses)
subtitle: in the rain / on TV / at the age of 16
summary: Learn the fixed expressions with in, on and at that are not about place or time - in the rain, on holiday, at the age of 16.

lesson.heading: in the rain, in the shade
lesson.text: We use **in** for the weather and the light around us: in the rain, in the sun, in the shade, in the dark, in bad weather, in fog.

examples.text: We sat **in the shade**. It was too hot to sit **in the sun**.
Don't go out **in the rain**. Wait until it stops.
Can you turn the light on? I don't want to sit **in the dark**.

lesson.heading: in French, in love, in my opinion
lesson.text: We also use **in** for languages and currencies, for **in love (with somebody)**, for **in a good/bad mood** and for **in my opinion**.

examples.text: How do you say 'thank you' **in Russian**?
How much is a hundred pounds **in dollars**?
They're very happy together. They're **in love**.
You seem to be **in a bad mood**. What's the matter?
**In my opinion** the film wasn't very good.

lesson.heading: on TV, on purpose, on the whole
lesson.text: We use **on** with media and a group of common expressions: on TV / on television, on the radio, on the phone, on fire, on purpose (= intentionally), on the whole (= in general).

examples.text: I didn't see the news **on TV**.
I've never met her, but I've spoken to her **on the phone**.
Look! That car is **on fire**.
I'm sorry. I didn't mean to hurt you. I didn't do it **on purpose**.
Sometimes I have problems at work, but **on the whole** I enjoy my job.

lesson.heading: on holiday, on strike, on a diet
lesson.text: We say **(be/go) on holiday**, **on a trip / on a tour / on a cruise**, **on business**, **on strike** and **on a diet**.

examples.text: I'm going **on holiday** next week.
One day I'd like to go **on a world tour**.
Emma's away **on business** at the moment.
There are no trains today. The drivers are **on strike**.
I've put on weight. I'll have to go **on a diet**.

lesson.note: We can also say go somewhere **for a holiday**: Steve has gone to France **for a holiday**.

lesson.heading: at the age of 16, at 100 degrees
lesson.text: We use **at** with an age, a speed, a temperature and an altitude.

examples.text: Tracy left school **at 16**.
The train was travelling **at 120 miles an hour**.
Water boils **at 100 degrees Celsius**.
We are now flying **at a speed of** 800 kilometres an hour and **at an altitude of** 9,000 metres.

lesson.heading: Quick reference
rows: in the rain / sun / shade / dark
in love / in a good mood
on holiday / on strike / on a diet

lesson.text: Two easy pairs to mix up: do something **on purpose** (not in purpose) and **on the whole** (not in the whole).

exercises.prompt: Don't go out ___. Wait until it stops.
exercises.explanation: Weather goes with in: in the rain, in the sun, in fog.

exercises.prompt: It's too hot here. I'm going to sit ___ under that tree.
exercises.explanation: We sit in the sun or in the shade.

exercises.prompt: How do you say 'thank you' ___ Russian?
exercises.explanation: Languages and currencies take in: in French, in dollars.

exercises.prompt: Workers at the company have gone ___ for better pay and conditions.
exercises.explanation: We say be/go on strike, like on holiday and on a diet.

exercises.prompt: There was panic when people realised that the building was ___.
exercises.explanation: The fixed expression is be on fire.

exercises.prompt: Julia's grandmother died recently ___ the age of 90.
exercises.explanation: Ages take at: at 16, at the age of 90.

exercises.prompt: Match the two halves of the sentences.

pairs.left: I shouldn't eat too much. I'm supposed to be
Jane's job involves travelling. She often goes away
Ben is a happy sort of person. He always seems to be

exercises.prompt: Which preposition goes with each expression?

exercises.statement: I'm sorry. It was an accident. I didn't do it in purpose.
exercises.explanation: I didn't do it on purpose. On purpose means intentionally.

exercises.prompt: Amanda thought the restaurant was OK, but ___ it wasn't very good.
exercises.explanation: We say in my opinion, not on or at my opinion.

exercises.prompt: I wouldn't like to go ___ a cruise. I think I'd get bored.
exercises.explanation: Journeys of this kind take on: on a trip, on a tour, on a cruise.

exercises.prompt: Some of the exam questions were hard, but ___ it was OK.
